description: This file defines an Android Activity named ChronometerDemo that demonstrates the use of the Chronometer widget, allowing users to start, stop, reset, and format the chronometer through button interactions.

classes.name: ChronometerDemo
classes.description: An Android activity that provides a simple user interface with a chronometer and control buttons to demonstrate starting, stopping, resetting, and formatting a chronometer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches click listeners to the control buttons.
